ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio; central fluke area displays high-intensity (white/light-grey) pixels (~75%) contrasted against low-intensity (black/dark-grey) peripheral margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white central region across both lobes. Low-intensity black contiguous regions form a frame along the trailing edge and outer lateral margins. Localized low-intensity circular pixel clusters (mottling) are scattered within the high-intensity white region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a high depth-to-width ratio at the central divide.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, moderate-amplitude serrations (saw-tooth pattern) along the continuous linear boundary of the trailing edge, particularly prominent on the lateral segments of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature from the median notch extending outward, transitioning to an upward sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups (barnacles) concentrated on the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, low-intensity unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) oriented vertically on the high-intensity white surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on distal tips; vertical rake marks/scratches on the ventral surface of the right lobe; jagged, irregular edges at the tips indicating potential minor trauma.
